# Ayaya headless source distribution

Source: https://github.com/AyayaXiaowang/Ayaya_Miliastra_Editor

GPLv3 source is included with its LICENSE and third-party notices. Modified: headless package initialization, CLI registration and offline dispatcher. The selected file list and original/modified SHA-256 hashes are in VENDORED.json. No upstream GUI, OCR, automation or game resource library is distributed.

Client and server GIL writeback templates are stored in `assets/gil-templates/` to fit Windows marketplace staging paths. VENDORED.json retains each original path and SHA-256.
